source_documents.title: Mechanochromism induced through the interplay between excimer reaction and excited state intramolecular proton transfer

reference_evidence_units.quote: Here we show the interplay between ESIPT and excimer formation in CF3-HTTH (2,2′-(thiazolo[5,4-d]thiazole-2,5-diyl)bis(4-(trifluoromethyl)phenol) solid crystal, resulting in the extensively broad multiple emissions spanning from 420 to 750 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.statement: ESIPT coupled with excimer formation gives triple emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: unveil the pre-equilibrium ESIPT between the normal (N*) and tautomer (T*) form, for which the slow population decay and well-ordered lattice packing facilitate excimeric (E*) formation, rendering N* (460 nm), T* (520 nm) and E* (600 nm) triple emissions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH

reference_evidence_units.quote: In contrast, the lower degree of packing on the solid surface prohibits excimer formation, showing only the ESIPT process.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.statement: Without ordered packing only ESIPT emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This viewpoint is supported by the disappearance of tautomer 520 nm emission in sol
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-MTTM (no OH)
reference_evidence_units.statement: Tautomer emission vanishes without the proton donor.
